data.spec: Add AGENT_PROVIDER=pydantic-ai (Python JSON subprocess; server owns SQLite/approval/execution). Existing DeviceEvent and statuses preserved. Proposal remains kind:'purchase'; optional fulfillment_kind:'goods'|'service', offer_id, expires_at ISO, sourcing:{weights:{price,quality,delivery},selected_offer_id,reason,alternatives:RankedOffer[],rejected:{offer_id,reason}[]}; RankedOffer {offer:{id,item_id,station_id,name,supplier,unit_price_nok,shipping_nok,delivery_hours,quality_score:0..100,quality_basis,available,fulfillment_kind,source:'fixture',expires_at,simulation:true},total_nok,score,components:{price,quality,delivery}}. All fixture data explicitly simulated. OfficeRequest optional research:[{title,url,snippet,source:'tavily',executable:false}]. Add POST /api/sensor-events {event_id,station_id,rule_id,value:number>=0,timestamp:ISO} -> {triggered:boolean,reason:string,request:OfficeRequest|null,duplicate:boolean}; rule_id references server-side configured metric/threshold/duration/hysteresis, never client-specified action. GET /api/procurement/config exposes approval/ranking/rules, no secrets. config/office.json require_approval boolean honored; default true. No web edits by this owner; UI can display optional sourcing/research and service fulfillment label.
